title: The panel comes back in the same frame as the selection it describes
goal: Clicking a layer after nothing was selected is the slowest click there is: the whole right hand panel has to be built from nothing, nine sliders, text fields and a colour well, and the click waits for all of it. The picture should react at once and the panel should catch up, so a click never feels like it is thinking.
notes: Follow-up from the selection latency work merged 2026-09-04, which took the common click from 63ms of main thread work to 46ms but left this one at a 53ms run loop pass. Cause is section creation: Position and Size, Effects, Shadow and Component all mount at once. Two options the runner should weigh and record: keep those sections mounted and hidden, or hand the dock its update one run loop pass after the canvas so handles land first. Measure with Scripts/playtest/select-click-perf-walk.json, which reports mainBusy and the longest pass per click.
acceptance: Measured with the selection walk: the click that brings the panel back after a deselect costs no more than a click that only moves the selection
The canvas handles and highlight appear in the first frame after the click, before the panel finishes
No section flickers or jumps as it arrives, and nothing is left blank once the panel settles
Numbers before and after are in the audit under queue/audits/, taken with the same walk
